subject: Recap + next steps: Legal routing & stakeholders for Acme pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@acmetech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps: Legal routing & stakeholders for Acme pilot

Hi Samira —

Great to meet with you and Tom today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the pilot: 

1) Summary of ask/criteria
- Pilot: 3-month inference pilot (internal search+chat) ~100k tokens/day during peak
- Decision criteria: latency <= 200ms p95, cost target < $0.003/token, and SOC2 + DPA controls

2) Stakeholder map (as discussed)
- Economic buyer: Tom Lee (you confirmed) — procurement/finance sign-off
- Security & legal: Tom to introduce legal owner for NDAs/MSA/DPA
- Technical sponsor: Samira (PO) + integration lead TBD

3) Legal / contracting ask
- We'll send our Redwood MSA + DPA (attached) for your legal team to redline.
- If you prefer to start with a mutual NDA signed, we can accept Acme's NDA first; you mentioned procurement prefers Acme-first routing.
- Typical turn times we see: NDA ~ 2-5 business days; MSA redlines ~ 7-20 business days depending on scope (we've carved a path where MSA review runs in parallel with SOW/pricing).

4) Proposed sequencing and next steps
- I will upload our standard MSA + DPA now (attached). Please confirm the legal contact who will receive the drafts.
- If Acme wants to use your MSA, please share the latest doc and we can review and prepare a redline.
- Proposed milestone: aim to have NDA executed and primary MSA comments by 2026-07-15 so procurement can trigger PO by end of month.

5) Action items
- Samira: introduce legal/procurement owners on reply (who should receive the docs).
- Marissa: share MSA/DPA and populate HubSpot with updated stakeholders (done).
- Neha: I've looped you for any technical/telemetry questions legal may ask.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short sync with legal/procurement if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Redwood-Standard-MSA-v1.pdf, Redwood-DPA-v1.pdf

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@acmetech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: Legal routing & stakeholders for Acme pilot

Thanks Marissa — super helpful recap.

Looping in our procurement and legal leads: Tom Lee (procurement lead) and legal@acmetech.com. Tom — Marissa sent Redwood's MSA + DPA; we prefer to run our NDA first (attached is our signed NDA — see Acme-NDA-signed.pdf). Can you confirm who from Redwood should receive our MSA and whether you prefer Acme's MSA?

A few clarifications from our side:
- Timeline: procurement is aiming to have commercial terms + PO ready by end of July if the legal cycle stays within typical turn times.
- Primary legal concerns: data residency clauses in the DPA and vendor right-to-audit.

Tom / Legal: any objections to the sequencing below? NDA -> DPA redline -> MSA negotiation in parallel with SOW/pricing.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Senior Product Manager, Search 
Acme Tech
samira.k@acmetech.com

Attachment: Acme-NDA-signed.pdf

From: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acmetech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.k@acmetech.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmetech.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: Legal routing & stakeholders for Acme pilot

Thanks both — quick note from procurement/legal side.

We did a quick glance at Redwood's MSA and DPA that you attached. A couple of notes up front:
- NDA: already signed by Acme (thanks Samira). Please countersign and return.
- DPA: our legal team will focus on data residency language and subprocessor disclosures. Expect a redline; target turnaround for DPA redline is ~7 business days once we've consolidated comments.
- MSA: procurement & legal prefer to start with Acme's MSA if Redwood is OK to redline on top — this usually speeds commercial acceptance. If Redwood prefers using your MSA, provide a summary of any uncommon clauses.

Turn times (rough):
- NDA: 1-3 business days (post receiving Redwood countersignature)
- DPA: 7-10 business days for initial redline
- MSA: 10-20 business days depending on level of redlines and whether we need exec review

Action items from Acme:
- Marissa: Please countersign the NDA and upload to the HubSpot deal (Tom will provide).
- Marissa/Neha: If you can send a short summary of any non-standard MSA clauses (indemnity, liability caps, export controls), that will help our legal prioritize.

Tom Lee
Head of Procurement | Acme Tech
Tom.Lee@acmetech.com

Procurement CC: procurement@acmetech.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acmetech.com>, Samira Khan <samira.k@acmetech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: Legal routing & stakeholders for Acme pilot

Tom — thanks for the clarity and target turn times, that helps a lot.

We countersigned the NDA (attached) and uploaded to the HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567). Attached again are our MSA + DPA; high-level call-outs below to speed review: 

Redwood MSA high-level callouts:
- Liability cap: Standard SaaS cap tied to fees paid in prior 12 months; open to negotiation in commercial terms.
- Indemnity: Mutual indemnities with data/security carve-outs; we can provide specific language for export controls if needed.
- Subprocessors: Full disclosure list available; we'll provide the current list and process for notification.

Redwood DPA callouts:
- Data residency: Redwood offers region pinning for Dedicated/Private deployments; for Hosted we can commit to EU/US region hosting per contract (we're happy to enumerate).
- Right to audit: Standard vendor audit windows; for enterprise customers we offer SOC2 report access and audit support.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I've countersigned the NDA and attached: Acme-NDA-countersigned.pdf (attachment uploaded to HubSpot).
- Neha will follow if legal asks for telemetry/integration details.
- Dev will prepare a short one-pager summarizing non-standard MSA clauses and current subprocessor list.

If that timeline works on your end we'll aim to get the DPA redline back within 7 business days and MSA comments in the 10-20 day window Tom described. Happy to set a 30-minute legal sync if you'd like to accelerate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood-Standard-MSA-v1.pdf, Redwood-DPA-v1.pdf, Acme-NDA-countersigned.pdf
